name: target_provoke
description: The Provoke turn: a provoker out of battle, dead or Petrified clears the bit (also for an actor that keeps control); an actor that keeps control otherwise ignores it; else the default attack at the provoker (single/self), its group (group type) or the legal set (all type), an empty record when the provoker is not legal.

function.signature: int provoke_turn(int user, Chr *chr, Rec *rec, int kind)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: out.ret is 0 nothing queued, -1 forced, -2 dropped; out.command and out.mask are the queued record (absent when nothing was queued), out.perm the actor permanent word afterwards.
